alembicBaseline.workingTree: Read current working-tree changes from preceding review; did not reset/edit them.

method: README_CN and directory maps first; bounded reads of recall/search/embedding facade and Proxy injection/client/bridge only. No install, launch, network request, live model, or external-repo write.

coreCallChains.name: host/legacy auto-recall
flow: L3 scoped profile + L2 scene index
session_init cache or fresh profile fetch
TdaiProfileMemoryInjector: fixed assets → parallel L3/L2 index
stable system suffix + static read-tool guide
LLM existing host tool → read-only memory bridge → Core v3 search/read
proxyCallChain.activeVsLegacy: TdaiL1RecallInjector file exists but current registration explicitly disables it (injection/index.ts:346-348). L0/L1 are currently on-demand tools; do not model retired file as default behavior.

interfacesAndBoundaries: MemoryCore owns IMemoryStore / EmbeddingService / StorageAdapter and isolated memory data; the core facade is host-neutral and does not host the Agent loop.
Proxy InjectionHook emits ContextBlock[] with point/priority/cacheStrategy; ProtocolAdapter owns conversion; HookCacheRepo stores injection snapshots separate from semantic memory.
Proxy read-only bridge derives authority-owned identity and credentials; never adopt its curl delivery mechanism into AlembicAgent where native typed tool contracts already exist.
MemoryCore nativeHybrid capability is delegated to storage; do not copy FTS/vector/nativeDB code into AlembicAgent.
budgetConcurrencyAndFailureFacts: Auto-recall default5000ms Promise.race produces RecallError20001 on deadline, but does not abort the losing inner promise. EmbeddingCallOptions only carries timeoutMs, not external AbortSignal.
Keyword+embedding search runs concurrently; per-path catches preserve other source. Native hybrid avoids duplicate local embedding request. Results over-fetched3x before filters and final limit.
Core recall snippet/total limits are character-based and default0 means unbounded; preserve Alembic explicit-zero-token semantics instead of copying defaults.

Proxy profile resolves self+max2 imported agents; per-agent L3/L2 calls run in parallel. L3 body capped6000chars, each L2 summary200, list boundedl2Limit. No global token budget was observed in InjectionPipeline.

Injection hooks run in point/priority order sequentially, per-hook failure recorded and does not abort pipeline. Profile prewarm is parallel/allSettled with20000ms default; its timers do not cancel underlying prewarm.
TdaiClient postForCtx enforces HTTP timeout but returns{} on network/HTTP/business failure, losing empty-vs-failure distinction. ACL errors deliberately fail-closed via checkAclOrDeny.
Memory bridge multi-source search preserves source_agent metadata and uses allSettled, but reports code0 after dropping failed sources; do not infer strong partial-error signaling.
Prompt says search<=3 calls per turn; this is prompt guidance in the inspected path, not a demonstrated runtime-enforced quota.

comparisons.tencent: Core splits appendSystemContext/prependContext; current Proxy freezes profile+index at session initialization and asks tools for detail.
comparisons.alembic: Already keeps base system prompt static and adds phase/ActiveContext as ephemeral provider input. No need to introduce an HTTP proxy or second hook runtime.

comparisons.tencent: Recall limits individual snippets and total body; profile injector sends scene paths/summaries rather than all full scene bodies.
comparisons.alembic: PersistentMemory now fits rendered token budget, ActiveContext keeps high-priority findings, SessionStore builds all completed reports in insertion order then truncates the string. Selection policies and token accounting are spread over3 modules.

comparisons.tencent: Structured search identifies effective strategy, parallel sources, stable IDs, source identity, latency/hits; several low-level errors still collapse to empty results.
comparisons.alembic: MemoryRetriever can perform lexical+embedding scoring but awaits optional embedding before ranking and silently falls back on throw; no request abort/deadline on embedding callback and no retrieval status returned.

evidence.claim: Unbounded embedding await with silent lexical fallback
Returned candidates touch access before later prompt budget filtering
Persistent section passes source/budget, not task query

comparisons.tencent: L2 index → scenario/read; L0/L1 search/query through a read-only bridge.
comparisons.alembic: Existing native registry already supports memory.get_previous_evidence and evidence.search/get, so use those surfaces. memory.recall is a different injected save/recall port and must not be equated with Agent SessionStore.

proposals.title: 统一有来源的记忆投影和预算装配
proposals.goal: 减少ActiveContext/SessionStore/PersistentMemory各自拼接字符串、估算token和解释截断的重复；保持静态/动态输入边界。
design: 引入Agent内部纯函数级MemorySection/MemoryEntry结构：id、scope/source、stability、priority、content、evidenceRefs、estimatedTokens；不新增通用插件框架。
让现有三个builder先产出候选section，集中执行去重、稳定排序、标题/分隔符/截断标记计费和token预算；旧build*Prompt继续返回string作为兼容包装。
可对同run/scope且数据版本未变的稳定section复用projection，动态section每轮刷新；仅内存缓存，变更findings/report/配置或scope后失效。不要新建Redis/COS/DB。
旁路diagnostics记录选入/省略/截断数量、所用预算与section来源；不得把历史记忆字符串提升成证据权威。

borrowedFrom.claim: Typed injection blocks and explicit stability policy
Snippet + aggregate budget and omission observability

behaviorTests: 同一run两轮仅动态进度变化，stable section字节一致，模型历史不累计动态注入。
中文/emoji/短预算含标题footer整体不超限；高优先短finding不被低优先长内容挤掉。
相同证据id跨section去重但来源信息保留；scope不同不可共享cache。
noteFinding/storeDimensionReport或budget改变后稳定projection失效；旧string facade与新projection渲染一致。
proposals.boundary: Agent上下文投影策略；不改Core schema/search/vector、宿主DI所有权及现有证据收据。

proposals.title: 前序维度先索引、命中后读取详情
proposals.goal: 避免SessionStore大报告抢占后续维度上下文，让最相关证据在固定预算内可被定位。
design: 在SessionStore已有report/findings/ref文件上构建轻量维度目录：dimId、短summary、finding数量、可用证据路径/真实已有refs；按currentDimId/focusKeywords和重要性挑选目录项。
在预算内直接展开少量最相关finding，其余保留可检索定位符，沿现有memory.get_previous_evidence或evidence.search/get取详情；不发明filesystem路径或E-id。
为现有memory.get_previous_evidence保留summary，同时可添加结构化items/受限分页，以闭合目录→详情；当前只渲染前8项且返回summary，应按真实handler契约完善，不声称已经提供完整报告读取。
保持原有full投影为默认兼容模式，先在明确的system-analysis profile用有测试的progressive选项；不削掉任务本来要求完整供给的strict context。

borrowedFrom.claim: Bounded scene listing distinct from body read
Discover index then read known path

behaviorTests: 几十个长报告、小预算、目标关键词只出现在较晚维度；目录仍包含目标而非只保留最早插入报告。
目录所列每个locator可经现有受控接口查回相同finding/证据；无匹配明确空结果。
未注入SessionStore/ledger时返回可观察degraded，不生成虚假详情入口。
重新恢复checkpoint后目录与证据一致；strict/producer仍只能消费已验证结构化发现。
proposals.boundary: 只改变已有Agent数据的读时projection与现有只读工具输出；不引入Tencent的HTTP/curl桥、身份租户系统或新的存储。

proposals.title: 召回有截止时间、取消语义和明确的降级结果
proposals.goal: 防止慢embedding阻塞prompt装配，并区分没有记忆与召回失败；与现有Agent取消/超时链一致。
design: 为可选embedding port增加兼容第二参数{abortSignal,deadlineMs/timeoutMs}；旧单参数回调仍可用但诊断明确其不支持底层取消。
在MemoryRetriever内部先计算词汇候选；embedding在请求剩余deadline内完成则合并当前评分，否则保留词汇结果并报告embedding-timeout/degraded。显式用户abort停止该次projection，不能伪装为正常无结果。
提供结构化内部RecallOutcome（items、strategy、status、warningCodes、elapsedMs、counts），旧retrieve():ScoredMemory[]/toPromptSection():string保留包装；避免用共享lastOutcome记录并发状态。
只对最终交付给消费者的item更新访问元数据；prompt投影中因预算未选入的候选不应在后台迟到完成时继续touchAccess。借用现有ReliabilityController/host AbortSignal，不复制Tencent重试实现。

borrowedFrom.claim: Independent retrieval sources and effective strategy

behaviorTests: 正常embedding与词汇路径保留当前排序；embedding缺失/拒绝/超时返回词汇候选并区分status。
预先abort不调用embedding；执行中abort及时返回且迟到promise不能改变accessCount或context。
一个来源失败不丢已有候选；两个并发scope/query的结果与诊断互不串线。
port忽略signal时deadline仍结束等待、观察promise失败避免unhandled rejection，明确记录底层取消不保证。
测试只用fake clock/mock embedding，不依赖API key或真实网络。
proposals.boundary: Agent异步召回编排/预算/观测接口增量；索引、向量算法、SQLite migration和Core仓储保持原位。

sourceEvidence.claim: MemoryCore owns memory/metadata; knowledge content is a different service, agents are consumers.
Proxy owns access/forwarding, MemoryCore owns memory storage/processing.
Host-neutral handleBeforeRecall delegates to performAutoRecall and reports retrieval metrics.
Recall wrapper has a 5000ms default deadline and structured timeout result.
Stable persona/navigation/tools text is separated from per-turn L1 recall text.
Query sanitized before configured retrieval strategy; explicit embedding configuration absence is a failure.
nativeHybridSearch capability avoids duplicate local embedding and a second storage request.
Local hybrid executes keyword/vector concurrently and merges ranked IDs with RRF.
Independent per-memory and total recall character budgets; counts dropped/truncated snippets.
Scene index is a sorted navigation projection; full content is fetched only on demand.
Structured L1 search accepts query, limit, type/scene and storage isolation filter.
Over-fetches limit*3, short-circuits native hybrid, otherwise parallel FTS/vector then filters and trims.
V3 requires team/agent/user; session optional; v2/v3 share handlers.
Atomic search validates schema, propagates identity filter, deliberately searches across sessions.
Per-call embedding contract exposes timeoutMs, not external AbortSignal.
Remote embedding uses per-attempt AbortController, HTTP classification and bounded retries.
Safe typed error category/code/retryable contract separates dependency failure from empty retrieval.
Request handler runs injection pipeline before forwarding; injection failure retains original body.
Actual memory registration uses profile injector and static read-tool instructions.
Legacy per-turn L1 recall injector is explicitly not registered in current default path.
Protocol adapter parse → context hooks → serialize orchestration.
Injection points and hook priority run deterministically; each hook failure is isolated.
none/session_init/hybrid strategies and multidimensional session cache keys.
Stable cached blocks precede fresh blocks; dedupe via metadata.cacheKey or type/content.
Parallel best-effort prewarm with per-hook and outer deadlines, optional clear-before refresh.
Actual profile hook uses system suffix, session_init cache, L3 content + L2 path/summary index.
Per-agent profile loads in parallel; no L2 body prefetch.
Each L3 body capped at6000 chars, each L2 summary at200; metadata identifies source/mode/counts.
Request-local fixed-asset resolution cache; self+at most2 imported agents, failure falls back to self.
Static instructions expose read-only retrieval/read operations without credentials in model context.
L2 index filtered to files and bounded by l2Limit; body retrieval is separate method.
Per-request HTTP timeout and identity headers; data-plane failures collapse to empty object.
ACL error path deliberately throws; checkAclOrDeny fails closed.
Bridge has explicit read-only endpoint allowlist.
Authority-owned identity override and per-upstream timeout; no raw credential in prompts.
Across-agent search uses allSettled, preserves source_agent metadata and truncates merged hits.

cautions: README/comments sometimes describe older behavior: searchMemories comment promiseskeyword fallback, actual missingconfiguredembedding fails; Proxy README L2/L3 wording is coarse, code injectsL3 + L2 index. Prefer cited code.
Do not copy raw preview/query logging for sensitive recall content; Alembic diagnostics should log bounded IDs/status/counts and retain redaction.
No new database, service, provider dependency, scheduler or HTTP proxy is required for these proposals.
